title: 第360章 才依依状元贾黑米探花第0359章 顶级武道大学录取通知
content_zh:
凰溪岛武道中心，万米露天比武场。
漫天散去的气血劲风缓缓平息，躁动了整整三日的决赛擂台，终于彻底归于平静。
擂台上两道相对而立的身影，此刻都微微喘息。
才依依白衣猎猎，周身萦绕的淡金色血脉灵光缓缓敛入体内，那双清冷如寒星的眸子此刻褪去了对战时的锐利锋芒，多了几分浅浅的诧异与动容。
她垂眸看着自己微微发麻的手腕，心底波澜翻涌。
从凰溪岛武道集训初见，到一路并肩闯过诡异事件、破解武道馆阴谋，再到今日武道高考决赛巅峰对决，她从未想过，这个半年前整个凰溪岛人人皆知的气血废柴，能硬生生站在自己对面，拼到不分胜负。
要知道，她乃是顶级武道世家嫡女，天生觉醒上古封印血脉，气血根基自幼打磨到极致，更是提前突破武者境后期，是本届武道高考公认的无冕之王。
可刚才那一战，贾黑米仅凭普通武者境后期的修为、二阶初期的心灵序列能力，硬生生接住了她附带血脉之力的绝杀一击。
最后一招碰撞的瞬间，那股纯粹、坚韧、不带丝毫戾气的心灵屏障，挡得稳如磐石，甚至震得她的血脉气血微微凝滞。
平局。
堂堂武道天才、蝉联历次统考第一的才依依，在全民关注的武道高考总决赛上，和曾经的底层废柴贾黑米，战成了平手。
看台之上，死寂持续了足足三秒。
下一秒，山呼海啸般的哗然与轰鸣骤然炸开！
“平了？！真的平了？！”
“我的天！贾黑米居然逼平了才依依？这是什么逆天逆袭！”
“半年前气血堪堪破百，连武者入门都难，现在直接打平高考状元热门，这成长速度简直离谱！”
“谁说心灵序列是鸡肋辅助序列？能正面硬刚血脉武道天赋，这也太夸张了！”
密密麻麻的观众席彻底沸腾，无数考生、武道老师、观战的世家子弟满脸难以置信，此起彼伏的议论声席卷整个比武场。
场外悬浮的数百块全息光屏，同步直播着决赛最终画面，瞬间刷屏整个凰溪岛武道论坛、主城武道热搜。
此前所有看衰贾黑米、嘲讽他越级碰瓷天才的言论，在这一刻彻底销声匿迹。

取而代之的，是铺天盖地的震撼与惊叹。
贵宾观礼席上，一众武道联盟高层神色复杂，纷纷点头赞叹。
盟主赵山河端坐主位，一身黑色武道制服，身姿挺拔威严，他望着擂台上的少年，眼中满是欣赏之色，缓缓开口：“后生可畏。凰溪岛这一次，出了两个绝世苗子。贾黑米的心灵序列，看似温和，实则攻守兼备、万法不侵，尤其是克制心灵侵蚀的特性，放在当下诡异频发、邪神低语泛滥的时代，价值远超普通强攻序列。”
身旁几位武道长老纷纷附和。
“确实难得。普通武者拼气血、拼招式，他拼的是心境、是执念。这份心性，放眼历届高考，也是顶尖之列。”
“刚才最后一式我看得真切，他的心灵屏障毫无破绽，就连被邪神低语轻微侵蚀的擂台残留怨念，都被瞬间净化，天赋太过特殊。”
“才依依的上古封印血脉更是罕见，攻守兼备，自带镇邪效果。这两个孩子，未来绝对是守护蓝星的中坚力量。”
人群角落，一袭朴素灰衣的叶利西负手而立，百岁沧桑的脸上挂着一抹淡然的笑意。
旁人看不清他眼底深处的深意，唯有他自己知晓。
自家徒儿这一战，根本没有尽全力。
贾黑米的心灵破障天赋，还藏着极大的底牌，众生心念加持、执念净化之力，方才对战全程半点未露。
他刻意收敛所有杀招与底牌，只用纯粹的自身气血和基础序列能力对决，既拼出了自身实力，又藏住了最大秘密，心性沉稳、进退有度，远超同龄武者。
“小黑子，终于熬出头了。”叶利西低声轻笑，百年积压的心头重担，稍稍卸下几分。
不远处，一道小巧的黑影蹲在看台栏杆上，通体乌黑的皮毛在阳光下发亮，金色竖瞳死死盯着擂台，正是地下水神探猫和。
它甩了甩尾巴，人性化地点了点头，低沉的猫鸣带着几分赞许。
从最初偶遇这个瘦弱坚韧的少年，到组队探查诡异、破解岛内阴谋，它早就清楚，贾黑米的强大，从来不在气血数值，而在无人能及的心灵底蕴。
另一边，人群外侧，穿着休闲工装、一身精明气质的花呗呗把玩着手中的异能交易卡牌，眼底闪过一抹惊艳。
“可以啊贾黑米，藏得够深。”她轻笑一声，眼底满是笃定，“看来我当初选择绑定合作，是这辈子最稳的一笔交易。心灵序列未来可期，跟着这小子，绝对稳赚不赔。”
她靠异能交易洞察人心、权衡利弊，见过无数天骄天才，却从未见过有人能在绝境逆袭至此，心境纯粹又坚韧，重情义、有底线，远比那些眼高手低、仗着天赋跋扈的世家子弟靠谱百倍。
擂台之上。

贾黑米缓缓收回周身萦绕的淡白色心灵灵光，绵长的气血在经脉中平稳流转。
经过刚才巅峰一战，他的气血彻底稳固在了三百赫大关，武者境后期的修为毫无虚浮，彻底夯实根基。
content_en:
Huangxi Island Martial Arts Center, a 10,000-meter open-air competition venue.
The strong wind of energy and blood dispersed in the sky slowly subsided, and the final arena, which had been restless for three days, finally returned to calm.
The two figures standing opposite each other on the ring were panting slightly at this moment.
Cai Yiyi hunted in white clothes, and the light golden blood aura lingering around her body slowly entered her body. Her eyes, as cold as cold stars, now lost the sharp edge they had during the battle, and now contained a bit of surprise and emotion.
She lowered her eyes and looked at her slightly numb wrist, and her heart was filled with waves.
From their first meeting at the martial arts training camp on Huangxi Island, to working together through strange events and solving the conspiracy of the martial arts hall, to today's peak showdown in the martial arts college entrance examination finals, she never thought that this good-for-nothing loser who was known to everyone on Huangxi Island half a year ago could stand opposite her and fight to the point of no win.
You must know that she is the legitimate daughter of a top martial arts family. She was born with the ancient sealed bloodline. Her Qi and blood foundation has been polished to the extreme since she was a child. She has broken through to the late stage of the warrior realm in advance and is recognized as the uncrowned king in this martial arts college entrance examination.
But in that battle just now, Jia Heimi only relied on his cultivation at the late stage of the ordinary warrior realm and his psychic sequence ability at the early stage of the second level to catch her decisive blow with the power of blood.
The moment the last move collided, that pure, tough, and devoid of any hostility, the spiritual barrier was as solid as a rock, and even caused her blood to stagnate slightly.
draw.
Cai Yiyi, a mighty martial arts genius who has topped all previous unified examinations, ended up in a tie with the former low-level loser Jia Heimi in the martial arts college entrance examination finals, which attracted national attention.
Above the stands, the dead silence lasted for three full seconds.
The next second, the uproar and roar like a mountain roar and a tsunami suddenly exploded!
"It's even?! It's really even?!"
"Oh my God! Jia Heimi actually tied Cai Yiyi? What kind of counterattack is this!"
"Half a year ago, my blood was so low that it was difficult to get started as a martial artist. Now I'm directly tied with the top candidate in the college entrance examination. This growth rate is simply outrageous!"
"Who said that the spiritual sequence is a useless auxiliary sequence? It is too exaggerated to be able to attack the bloodline martial arts talent head-on!"
The densely packed auditorium was in complete excitement. Countless candidates, martial arts teachers, and disciples from aristocratic families who were watching the battle had expressions of disbelief on their faces. Debates swept through the entire competition arena.
Hundreds of holographic light screens suspended outside the stadium simultaneously broadcast the final scene of the finals, instantly sweeping the entire Huangxi Island Martial Arts Forum and the main city's Martial Arts hot searches.
All previous comments that looked down upon Jia Heimi and ridiculed him as a genius who jumped to the next level completely disappeared at this moment.
Instead, there was overwhelming shock and amazement.
At the VIP viewing table, the top brass of the martial arts alliance had complicated expressions and nodded in admiration.
The leader of the alliance, Zhao Shanhe, was sitting on the throne, wearing a black martial arts uniform, with a tall and majestic posture. He looked at the young man on the ring, his eyes full of admiration, and slowly said: "The young people are terrible. This time, Huangxi Island has produced two peerless talents. Jia Heimi's spiritual sequence may seem gentle, but in fact it is both offensive and defensive. It is invulnerable, especially the characteristic of restraining spiritual erosion. In the current era of frequent weirdness and the proliferation of whispers of evil gods, its value is far more than ordinary attack sequences."
Several martial arts elders around him agreed.
"It is indeed rare. Ordinary warriors fight for energy and skills, but he fights for his state of mind and obsession. This kind of character is also among the top in all previous college entrance examinations."
"I saw the last move clearly just now. There was no flaw in his mental barrier. Even the residual resentment in the ring that was slightly eroded by the evil god's whisper was instantly purified. His talent is too special."
"Cai Yiyi's ancient sealed bloodline is even rarer. It is both offensive and defensive, and has its own evil-suppressing effect. These two children will definitely be the backbone of protecting Blue Star in the future."
In the corner of the crowd, Ye Lixi, dressed in simple gray clothes, stood with his hands behind his hands, a faint smile on his century-old face.
Others couldn't see clearly the deep meaning in his eyes, onlyHe knows it himself.
My disciple didn't try his best in this battle.
Jia Heimi's talent for breaking mental barriers also hides a huge trump card. The power of blessing the minds of all living beings and purifying obsessions was not revealed at all during the whole battle just now.
He deliberately restrained all his killing moves and trump cards, and only used his pure energy and basic sequence abilities to fight. He not only demonstrated his own strength, but also hid his biggest secret. His calm mind and measured advance and retreat were far superior to those of warriors of the same age.
"Little Heizi, you finally got through it." Ye Lixi chuckled softly, and the burden that had been accumulated for a hundred years was slightly relieved.
Not far away, a small black figure squatted on the railing of the stand, its black fur shining in the sun, and its golden vertical eyes staring intently at the ring. It was none other than Nekowa, the underground water detective.
It flicked its tail, nodded humanely, and made a low meow with a hint of approval.
From the initial encounter with this thin and tough young man, to the team-up to explore the strange and solve the conspiracy on the island, it has long understood that the strength of Jia Heimi has never been in the blood value, but in the spiritual foundation that no one can match.
On the other side, outside the crowd, Hua Beibei, who was wearing casual work clothes and a shrewd temperament, was playing with the power trading cards in his hand, with a flash of surprise in his eyes.
"It's okay, Jia Heimi, it's hidden deep enough." She chuckled, her eyes full of determination, "It seems that the binding cooperation I chose was the most stable deal in my life. The future of the psychic sequence is promising. If you follow this kid, you will definitely make money without losing anything."
She relies on supernatural power trading to gain insight into people's hearts and weigh the pros and cons. She has seen countless geniuses, but she has never seen anyone who can counterattack in desperate situations. She has a pure and tenacious mentality, values friendship, and has a bottom line. She is far more reliable than those children of aristocratic families who have high vision but low hand and rely on their talent to be domineering.
On the stage.
Jia Heimi slowly withdrew the pale white spiritual light lingering around him, and the long qi and blood flowed steadily in his meridians.
After the peak battle just now, his Qi and blood were completely stable at the 300 Hz mark, and his cultivation in the late warrior realm was completely solid, and his foundation was completely solid.
